notes: Edit freely. 'market' is printed on the ideas slide (keep it short and sourced). 'sources' go in the speaker notes. Only add market claims you trust or have sourced, with the date checked. The slide shows the first 6 ideas. We sell across the UK and Ireland, so location-bound prizes (lessons, golf breaks, venue or simulator-bay vouchers) are left out. Confirm stock, insured delivery to NI and the Republic of Ireland, and the exact spec with suppliers before listing. 'keywords' find runs of the exact prize; 'related' finds similar prizes, shown separately as related history (never counted as the idea itself).
